# $_GET

$\_GET is a pre-defined array in PHP, that's used to collect form-data sent through HTTP GET method. It's useful whenever you need to process or interact with data that has been passed in via a URL's query string. For an example if you have a form with a GET method, you can get the values of the form elements through this global $\_GET array. HereΓÇÖs an example:

    <form method="get" action="test.php">
      Name: <input type="text" name="fname">
      <input type="submit">
    </form>
    

Using $\_GET in `test.php`, you can fetch the 'fname' value from the URL:

    echo "Name is: " . $_GET['fname'];
